findings.passage: First, we need to enact Automatic Voter Registration to remove that first hurdle to having people exercise their right to vote. Second, like other states who have successfully implemented vote by mail, we should allow county officials to begin counting ballots before election day, without publicly releasing results, to ensure that we have a timely, accurate count on election day.
findings.note: Candidate answer published by The Keystone in a survey of State Senate candidates on changing voting laws, when he was a challenger. Covers registration and mail ballot counting; says nothing on ID or citizenship proof.
